//: EAS build profiles. See docs/setup.md for which one to use when.

development.//: A dev client you install on your own phone. It still talks to the emulators on your laptop over Wi-Fi, exactly like Expo Go does, but it is a real native app — so native modules work and you can see how the app actually behaves off a dev server's leash. This is the only profile that works today.

preview.//: A standalone app for testing on real phones, pointed at the loane-dev Firebase project. Needs that project to exist and to have functions, rules and indexes deployed to it.

production.//: The App Store build, pointed at the live loane-code project. Nothing goes here without Zack saying so, every time.
